title: mantid · Vibe train AI models
excerpt: Point mantid at data you already have. It trains a model on your own machine and tells you straight whether it is any good. Free, no account required.
content_html:
Feed mantid the data and files you already have. Train an ML model that predicts and forecasts, or train a custom LLM for general AI.

Free. No account required. Your data never leaves your computer.

Drop in your data. mantid trains the ML model.

Bring what you have.

A spreadsheet, an export, a folder of PDFs. mantid reads it and says what it can do with it.

Pick a question.

mantid suggests questions your data can answer (or type your own).

Go and make a cup of tea.

It trains on your machine while you relax. mantids are patient.

Get a verdict.

mantid reports back on the custom AI model.

Put it to work.

Drop in next week's data to get answers, or export the model into your own project.

appointments.csv

Questions this file can answer:

Who won't turn up tomorrow?

Learns from the no_show column

How many people book next week?

Counts appointments by day

Who cancels at the last minute?

Needs a cancelled column, which you don't have yet

Or ask your own

Which patients keep rebooking?

Bad models get eaten.

Every model is measured against the simplest guess anyone could make from the same data. mantid tells you whether it beat that guess, and what would help if it didn't.

Retrain your models with versioning.

Nothing is overwritten. Go back to any version you liked better.

Every verdict comes with a fix.

Add data, correct a mistake, set a rule, then run it again.

Bad Example: churn, version 2

This model doesn't beat the simple guess.

Simple guess 97%

This model 96%

The simple guess says nobody leaves. It is right 97 times in 100. Your model is right 96.

What would help: only 38 of your 1,200 customers left, so add a column like last_login and bring two years of customers instead of one.

Drop in your documents and data. mantid trains your own LLM on them, then you use it like any assistant, on your own machine.

Ask your documents

Put it to work

Tested before you use it

Pricing. Nom nom.

Free

You read that right.

Train as much as you like on your own machine. Nothing to pay and no account.

  • Train as many ML models and LLMs as you like on your data.
  • Use them on new data, files and folders of documents.
  • Export your models for DIY deployment.
  • Call your models in your AI tools with a local MCP.
  • Your data never leaves your machine.

A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later), macOS 14 or later. ML models need 8 GB of memory, LLMs need 16 GB. Anonymous usage data is on by default and can be switched off.

Hosted with API & MCP

Use your models in any platform, AI tool or vibe coded app. High uptime, low cost, usage based fees.
